items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: Well, there's another bass player named Turner.

ctx.x: No, he didn't die there, he died in Chicago.
Oh, I see. Well, there's another bass player named Turner. Not in my band. I must have been more confused, you know. Because... Could be two guys with the same name.
Yeah, well, we call him Nick. What was Nick's name? Henry Turner.
